meta.description: World-drop gear pools by level and quality. Items are keyed by entry; pools list entries. See docs/reference/items-and-vendors.md.
meta.source: vmangos world DB (github.com/vmangos/core release db_latest, sqlite) + 1.12.1 client DBCs

pool_level_rule: pool_level = item_level for gear and bags; for grey vendor trash (item level 1 in the DB) the median level of the open-world mobs that drop it. A mob of level L should roll pools L-2..L+2.

random_enchant.note: World-drop items whose stats are rolled at drop time ("of the Bear" etc.). Not in the fixed pools above. To use one, roll suffix_tables[random_property] by chance_pct, send the property id in ITEM_FIELD_RANDOM_PROPERTIES_ID (the client renders the suffix and stat lines from ItemRandomProperties.dbc) and apply mods server-side. Without that the item would show and act stat-less.

dungeon_blues.note: wailing_caverns: every blue any Wailing Caverns creature can drop in 1.12. wailing_caverns_only marks the instance's own named drops; the rest are world-drop BoE blues WC trash shares with the open world. level_17_25_warrior_blues: other blue drops (dungeon or world) with required level 17-25, fixed stats and no unsupported spell, usable by a Warrior. proposed_boss_pool: the WC blues a Warrior can sensibly use (fixed stats, no unsupported spell, no caster-only stats, no cloth body armour) plus the required-level 18-22 extras.
